criteria.description: The workbook opens and contains every required DCF sheet.
Each forecast-period revenue formula agrees with the independent replay.
The EBIT-to-NOPAT bridge agrees with the independent replay in every forecast period.
The D&A, capex, NWC, and UFCF bridge agrees with the independent replay in every forecast period.
Forecast discount factors and present values agree with the independent replay.
The terminal FCF, terminal value, and discounted terminal value agree with the independent replay.
The forecast-PV, enterprise-value, net-debt, and equity-value bridge agrees with the independent replay.
Every declared WACC-by-terminal-growth sensitivity coordinate is formula-linked and correct.
The terminal forecast revenue responds correctly to the declared growth perturbation.
Enterprise value responds correctly to the declared WACC perturbation.
The declared historical source cells remain unchanged.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查五年预测、无杠杆现金流、终值、企业价值到股权价值的调整和敏感性结果。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 题面明确要求五张工作表；在这个结构内按标签和财务关系查找结果，再用独立重算核对。
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 工作簿无法读取，或关键预测与估值区域无法可靠定位时，应先记录评分程序的识别问题。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 现有规则总体稳定，仍需用真实答卷检查标签别名和敏感性表的替代布局。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
